tuning.why: The recap parts under about 90s (10 Cloverfield Lane parts 1–8 at 58–85s, plus Fall parts 2–4) drew most of the recap views, while the 158–190s Blink Twice recaps averaged far less, so 165 is a single 30s step toward shorter parts.
The 165 s change was followed by Elysium parts 2–7 (165–288 s) drawing 2 views total, while the sub-90 s recap parts drew the most, so I moved the length down one 30 s step to 135 s.

Elysium parts 2–7 (165–288 s), posted after the Oct 29 change to 165 s, drew 2 views total while sub-90 s Cloverfield and Fall recap parts drew 300–490 each, so I'm stepping down 30 s to 105 s; the Nov 4 change to 135 has no posts since to judge it by.

Recap parts at 105 s (Dune, 6 videos) averaged 14.5 views and 2.9 s watched, against 33 views and 6.3 s for the roughly 135 s Midsommar parts, so I'm stepping back up 30 s to 135 s; the 165 s step before that drew almost nothing.

ai.summary: The channel has real reach but weak holding power: 106,828 views, yet 33,700 come from one Elysium part and 56,200 from an untagged 'I like banana' video, and viewers leave early (4.9 s average watch, 1.1% full watch). Recap parts are the only format with real volume, so the fix that matters most is opening each part with a hook and ending it on a cliffhanger.
